headline: Nigerian Breweries Eliminates Accumulated Losses, Boosting Dividend Hopes
summary: Nigerian Breweries Plc has fully cleared its accumulated losses, turning group retained earnings positive to N34.79 billion as of September 30, 2026, down from a N72.17 billion deficit at the end of December 2025.
why: Clearing accumulated deficits removes balance-sheet restrictions on earnings distribution, bringing the prominent consumer-goods company closer to resuming dividend payments for shareholders.

impacts.name: Nigerian Breweries Plc
impacts.why: Eliminating historical deficits improves financial health and brings resumption of dividend distributions closer.
